'''Brian C. Moyer''' is an American economist who is the director of the U.S. [[National Center for Health Statistics]].<ref>[https://www.cossa.org/2020/03/17/nchs-taps-bea-director-brian-moyer-to-lead-agency/ NCHS Taps BEA Director Brian Moyer to Lead Agency]. Consortium of Social Science Associations. March 17, 2020.</ref> Moyer serves as senior advisor to the [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] and to the secretary of the [[U.S. Department of Health and Human Services]]; he also serves as the statistical official for the department.

==Education==
Moyer received a bachelor's and master's degrees in economics from the [[University of Maryland]] and a Ph.D. in economics in 2002 from [[American University]].<ref name=staffbio>[https://www.bea.gov/research/bio/moyer_brian_c.htm Research at BEA: Staff Biography] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180129222333/https://www.bea.gov/research/bio/moyer_brian_c.htm |date=2018-01-29 }} at bea.gov.</ref><ref name=amstat>[https://web.archive.org/web/20150910040732/http://magazine.amstat.org/blog/2015/01/01/meet-brian-moyer-director-of-the-bureau-of-economic-analysis/ Meet Brian Moyer, Director of the Bureau of Economic Analysis], ''Amstat News'', 1 Jan 2014, [[American Statistical Association]] web site.</ref><ref>[http://bea.gov/about/orgchart_director.htm Director and Acting Deputy Director of the Bureau of Economic Analysis] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303224304/http://bea.gov/about/orgchart_director.htm |date=2016-03-03 }} at bea.gov.</ref><ref>[http://www.allgov.com/news/appointments-and-resignations/director-of-the-bureau-of-economic-analysis-who-is-brian-moyer-150523?news=856555 Director of the Bureau of Economic Analysis: Who Is Brian Moyer?] at allgov.com.</ref>

==Career==
Moyer spent more than 25 years with the [[U.S. Department of Commerce]]. He served as Director of the [[Bureau of Economic Analysis]] (BEA), where he led modernization efforts to improve official economic statistics, including the measures of [[gross domestic product]] (GDP).<ref name=wsj>Eric Morath. [https://blogs.wsj.com/economics/2014/09/09/commerce-department-picks-brian-moyer-to-lead-number-crunching-for-gdp-and-other-key-reports/ Commerce Department Picks Brian Moyer To Lead Number-Crunching for GDP and Other Key Reports] ''[[The Wall Street Journal]]'', 9 Sep 2014.</ref><ref name=staffbio/>
